source.baseStandard:
(1) 성상 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 회황색의 내용물을 함유한 밝은 빨간색 연질캡슐
(2) 비타민 B6 : 표시량(33mg/1000mg)의 80 ~ 150%
(3) 판토텐산 : 표시량(22.5mg/1000mg)의 80 ~ 180%
(4) 아연 : 표시량(8.5mg/1000mg)의 80 ~ 150%
(5) 망간 : 표시량(3mg/1000mg)의 80 ~ 150%
(6) 비타민 B1 : 표시량(1.2mg/1000mg)의 80 ~ 180%
(7) 비타민 B2 : 표시량(1.4mg/1000mg)의 80 ~ 180%
(8) 대장균군 : 음성
(9) 붕해시험 : 20분 이내
source.caution:

Health Functional FoodManganese 3mgVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin B6 33mgZinc 8.5mgPantothenic acid 22.5mg2 times a day

토탈바이오맥스Manganese · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Zinc · Pantothenic acid

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · 2 times a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 3mg of Manganese, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 33mg of Vitamin B6, 8.5mg of Zinc, 22.5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 capsule): 3mg Manganese, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 33mg Vitamin B6, 8.5mg Zinc, 22.5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Manganese
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Manganese labelled (3mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (33mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (22.5mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 회황색의 내용물을 함유한 밝은 빨간색 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘한 곳에 보관 및 유통(실온)

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Manganese · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Zinc · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
